title: Add admin panel comment list management with lock controls and usage tracking

requirements.text: Add lock/unlock toggle functionality to existing comment lists in the admin panel. When a list is locked, prevent users from generating comments from that list on the customer-facing page. Display a lock icon next to each list in the admin panel to indicate lock status.

quotes: it restrict user to take comments if it lock by admin

acceptanceCriteria: Each comment list in the admin panel displays a clickable lock icon
Clicking the lock icon toggles the list between locked and unlocked states
Locked lists are visually indicated with a locked padlock icon
On the customer view page, locked lists cannot be selected for comment generation
Lock state persists across page refreshes

requirements.text: Add available vs. used comment tracking for each list. Display badges showing the count of available (unused) comments and used comments in the list management interface. Track when comments are generated and mark them as 'used'.
acceptanceCriteria: Display '85 available' and '5 used' style badges in the Managing interface
Available count shows comments that have not been generated yet
Used count shows comments that have been generated at least once
Counts update in real-time when comments are added or generated
Total in 'Comments in List (90)' equals available + used

requirements.text: Add a refresh button next to the delete button in the Managing interface that reloads the current list's comments and usage statistics from the backend.
acceptanceCriteria: Refresh button appears next to the red delete button in the Managing section
Clicking refresh fetches the latest comment data from the backend
Available/used counts update after refresh
Comment list below updates to show current comments

requirements.text: Update the 'Add X Comments' button text to dynamically show the count of comments entered in the bulk upload textarea (e.g., 'Add 0 Comments' when empty, 'Add 5 Comments' when 5 lines are entered).
acceptanceCriteria: Button text displays 'Add 0 Comments' when textarea is empty
Button text updates to 'Add X Comments' where X is the line count
Count updates in real-time as user types in the textarea
Each line break counts as one comment

requirements.text: In the 'Comments in List' section, display individual comments with trash icons for deletion. Show the available and used counts as separate badges (e.g., '85 available' in green, '5 used' in orange).
acceptanceCriteria: Each comment displays in a card with a trash icon on the right
Clicking the trash icon deletes that specific comment
Available count badge appears in green styling
Used count badge appears in orange styling
Badges appear below the 'Comments in List (90)' heading

requirements.text: Add a 'Bulk Comment Totals' dashboard section that displays a summary card for each comment list showing the list name and total comment count (e.g., 'Stasfin: 90', 'TEO FIN - PERSONAL LOAN: 50').
acceptanceCriteria: Bulk Comment Totals section appears below the Existing Lists section
Each list displays in a card with the list name and total count
Total count appears in a blue bordered badge on the right
Section includes an icon and descriptive subtitle
Dashboard updates when lists are created or comments are added

requirements.text: Add a 'Danger Zone' section at the bottom of the admin panel with a red 'Clear All Comment Lists' button that deletes all comment lists and their contents after confirmation.
acceptanceCriteria: Danger Zone section appears at the bottom with red heading
Section includes warning text about irreversible actions
Red 'Clear All Comment Lists' button with trash icon
Clicking the button shows a confirmation dialog
Confirming deletes all lists and comments from the backend
UI updates to reflect empty state after deletion

requirements.text: Ensure all backend operations properly persist data so that created lists, added comments, lock states, and usage tracking survive canister upgrades and page refreshes.

quotes: Make sure all functions work fine after entering data

acceptanceCriteria: Comment lists persist across page refreshes
Lock states persist across page refreshes
Available/used tracking persists across page refreshes
All data survives canister upgrades
No data loss when adding or deleting comments

constraints: Do not change the existing AdminCommentsTab component structure
Maintain compatibility with the existing useAdminComments hook
Keep the existing Motoko backend single-actor architecture
Do not modify Internet Identity authentication logic
Preserve the existing tab-based admin panel layout
nonGoals: Real-time WebSocket updates between admin and customer views
Multi-user concurrent editing of comment lists
Import/export of comment lists to external formats
Advanced search or filtering of comments within lists
Role-based access control beyond the existing admin token system
